messages:
maria-oncall: Canary for /prompt-mux-new (us-west-2) is showing a spike in 5xx and p50 latency doubled. Enabling emergency kill now.
incident-bot: [ALERT] route=prompt-mux-new | env=prod | region=us-west-2 | error_rate=17% | p50_latency=415ms. Paging oncall.
maria-oncall: Running kill switch:
```
flagsctl set prompt_mux_v3 emergency_kill true --env=prod --reason "canary 5xx surge"
```
maria-oncall: Kill applied. Verifying traffic shift to stable.
sam-eng: Can you drop recent failed request samples/log lines so we can triage?
maria-oncall: Router log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:01Z] route=prompt-mux-new req_id=abc123 status=502 upstream_err=proto_mismatch
[2026-03-17T10:12:04Z] route=prompt-mux-new req_id=abc124 status=504 upstream_err=kv_cache_timeout
[2026-03-17T10:12:06Z] route=prompt-mux-new req_id=abc125 status=500 stack=kv_get
[2026-03-17T10:12:10Z] route=prompt-mux-new req_id=abc126 status=503 upstream_err=decoder_error
[2026-03-17T10:12:15Z] route=prompt-mux-new req_id=abc127 status=502
```
erin-sre: Confirm stable route handled the diverted traffic and didn't overload?
maria-oncall: Confirmed. routingctl status shows active_variant: stable, emergency_kill: true, traffic_shift: 100%. Stable pool CPU/util unchanged.
incident-bot: [INFO] emergency_kill set by maria-oncall at 2026-03-17T10:13:02Z. Escalation list notified.
jack-customer-success: We have a CS ticket reporting timeouts in last 10m. Any customer-visible errors to share?
maria-oncall: Estimated impacted sessions ~420 in 12m. Most retried and succeeded on stable. Drafting customer note after stabilization.
olivia-product: Recommend aborting canary rollout and rolling back canary hosts to previous image until root cause known.
sam-eng: Agreed. Starting rollback now:
```
git revert --no-edit abc1234-canary-deploy
deployctl start --pipeline canary-prompt-mux --env prod --strategy rollback
```
sam-eng: Rollback in progress, ETA ~4m.
erin-sre: Running post-rollback health checks and verifying heap/cpu on canary hosts. Will escalate on any cascading alarms.
maria-oncall: Handoff to mike-sre for continued monitoring and postmortem prep in 10m if noisy. @mike-sre please take pager.
mike-sre: Taking it. Will preserve logs and collect traces for forensics.
jack-customer-success: I'll notify affected customers with a short transparent note and offer follow-up logs.
olivia-product: Also add a regression test for the KV cache path; logs show kv_get/timeouts.
sam-eng: Rollback complete. Observability: error rate returned to baseline within 90s after traffic shifted back. :white_check_mark: 
maria-oncall: Emergency kill remains enabled until root cause confirmed. Monitoring for 15m before considering flag removal. CS notified, rollback applied, oncall handed to mike-sre.
incident-bot: [MITIGATION] emergency_kill=true, canary rollback complete. Incident owner: sam-eng; oncall: mike-sre. Continue monitoring.
mike-sre: Starting incident writeup and attaching logs/timeline to #postmortems. Follow-ups: eng-ml to triage model I/O, eng-runtime to review router kernel selection and KV cache behavior.
olivia-product: Keep customer comms concise. Thanks everyone.
maria-oncall: Closing this thread — mitigated. Reopen if errors reappear. Final: mitigated, customer impact limited, rollback and kill-switch applied. :eyes:
